title: Injective-resolution comparisons and sign correction for row pages
statement: Let $F:\mathcal A\to\mathcal B$ be additive and left exact between Grothendieck abelian categories [def-sp-left-exact-additive, def-sp-grothendieck-abelian]. Let $K$ be bounded below and $a:K\to I$ a bicomplex augmentation into termwise injective rows, each a quasi-isomorphic resolution of $K^s$ [def-sp-injective-resolutions]; assume $I^{s,\bullet}=0$ for $s<b$ for some $b$. For a subcomplex filtration $L$ of the flipped mapped total [def-sp-cartan-eilenberg-presentation] with steps the second-filtration sums [def-sp-double-complex-total], there exist $E,e_0,e_1$ with the page-zero and cycle/boundary quotient clauses of [lem-sp-second-filtration-row-cohomology], but with $e_1:E_1^{s,r}\cong R^rF(K^s)$ and unsigned differential $d_1e_{1,r,s+1}=e_{1,r,s}R^rF(d_K^{s,s+1})$. The negative complementary degrees of page one vanish. No convergence assertion is made.

proof.text: Bundle each given augmented row as an InjectiveResolution with cocomplex I.X s, injectivity hterms s, augmentation a.f s and quasi-isomorphism hrows s. Apply lem-sp-second-filtration-row-cohomology to obtain the spectral sequence, row cohomology comparisons, signed d1 equation and negative-degree vanishing. Multiply the comparison at (s,r) by (-1)^(r*s). The Lean calculation using Int.negOnePow_add and Int.units_mul_self cancels the consecutive (-1)^r factor. Compose these corrected comparisons with InjectiveResolution.isoRightDerivedObj F r inverses. The degree-zero augmentation equation follows by evaluating a.comm s (s+1) at zero, and Mathlib InjectiveResolution.isoRightDerivedObj_inv_naturality supplies the required right-derived naturality equation. No resolution is chosen from an existence theorem.

theorem cartanEilenberg_row_pages
    {A : Type uA} [Category.{vA} A] [Abelian A] [IsGrothendieckAbelian.{vA} A]
    {B : Type uB} [Category.{vB} B] [Abelian B] [IsGrothendieckAbelian.{vB} B]
    (F : A ⥤ B) [F.Additive] [PreservesFiniteLimits F]
    (K : CochainComplex.Plus A)
    (I : HomologicalComplex₂ A (ComplexShape.up ℤ) (ComplexShape.up ℕ))
    (a : ((CochainComplex.single₀ A).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj
      K.obj ⟶ I)
    (hbelow : ∃ b : ℤ, ∀ s : ℤ, s < b → IsZero (I.X s))
    (hterms : ∀ (s : ℤ) (r : ℕ), Injective ((I.X s).X r))
    (hrows : ∀ s : ℤ, QuasiIso (a.f s))
    (L : DecreasingFiltration
      ((((CartanEilenbergPresentation.mappedFunctor F).obj I).flip).total
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ)))
    (hL : ∀ p n : ℤ, L.complexStep p n =
      ((((CartanEilenbergPresentation.mappedFunctor F).obj I).flip).secondFiltration n).step
        p) :
    ∃ (E : CohomologicalSpectralSequence B 0)
      (e₀ : ∀ p q : ℤ, (E.page 0).X (p, q) ≅ (L.gradedPiece p).X (p + q))
      (e₁ : ∀ (r : ℕ) (s : ℤ), (E.page 1).X (s, (r : ℤ)) ≅
        (F.rightDerived r).obj (K.obj.X s)),
      (∀ p q : ℤ, (E.page 0).d (p, q) (p, q + 1) ≫ (e₀ p (q + 1)).hom =
        (e₀ p q).hom ≫ (L.gradedPiece p).d (p + q) (p + (q + 1))) ∧
      (∀ (p q t : ℤ) (ht : 1 ≤ t),
        ∃ hBZ : L.complexBoundaries p (p + q) t ≤ L.complexCycles p (p + q) t,
          Nonempty ((E.page t (le_trans (by decide : (0 : ℤ) ≤ 1) ht)).X (p, q) ≅
            cokernel (Subobject.ofLE _ _ hBZ))) ∧
      (∀ (r : ℕ) (s : ℤ),
        (E.page 1).d (s, (r : ℤ)) (s + 1, (r : ℤ)) ≫ (e₁ r (s + 1)).hom =
          (e₁ r s).hom ≫ (F.rightDerived r).map (K.obj.d s (s + 1))) ∧
      (∀ p q : ℤ, q < 0 → IsZero ((E.page 1).X (p, q)))
